Responsibilities: Zamzam Travels BD is a trusted organization providing services for Hajj, Umrah, visa processing, air ticketing, and travel services. We are looking to hire multiple Sales Executives to work on telephone communication, follow-ups, and sales conversions with potential leads at our establishment.

Responsibilities:
- Communicate with leads over the phone in coordination with the team leader.
- Provide information to clients about Hajj, Umrah, visa, tickets, and travel services based on their needs.
- Regularly follow up with potential clients.
- Maintain accurate lead, call status, and follow-up information.
- Work on sales conversion by understanding and explaining services to customers.
- Answer customer queries via phone, WhatsApp, and other mediums.
- Coordinate with the office team to share package, pricing, and other information.
- Maintain good relationships with new and existing clients.
- Provide daily call reports and work updates.
- Work towards achieving set sales targets.

Educational Qualifications:
- Minimum HSC/Diploma/Graduation.
- Preference will be given to candidates with good communication skills.

Experience:
- Freshers can also apply.
- Prior experience in telemarketing, call center, travel agency, customer support, or sales will be an advantage.

Additional Qualifications:
- Must have the ability to speak Bengali fluently.
- Basic communication skills in English are preferred.
- Ability to explain services to customers over the phone.
- Should be smart, polite, responsible, and hardworking.
- Basic computer skills are required.
- Familiarity with MS Word, Excel, Google Sheet, Email, and WhatsApp.
- Must have a mindset to work under pressure.

Salary and Benefits:
- Salary: Negotiable based on discussion/experience.
- Attractive incentives.
- Other benefits as per company policy.
